Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USDT price on Binance reaches or exceeds $90,000 at any point before the market's settlement time.
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USDT price on Binance remains below $90,000 at all times up to and including the market's settlement time.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches" means the BTC/USDT spot price on Binance touches or trades at or above $90,000 (i.e., any recorded trade price ≥ $90,000) during the market's active window.
